issues.existing: a gibbous moon in the upper right sky
issues.observed: a crescent moon in the upper right sky
issues.evidence: The lit area of the disc is a band along the right and lower-right rim, and its inner terminator is concave toward that lit limb — the signature of a crescent. The shadowed portion covers clearly more than half the disc (the unlit remainder is faintly visible as a pale circle). A gibbous phase would show the lit region covering more than half with a convex terminator; that is not what is painted.
